DIESEL_REFINING_CRISIS.shock: middle-distillate crack spreads / physical diesel scarcity
DIESEL_REFINING_CRISIS.earnings_channel: higher product cracks can expand refinery capture margins when crude feedstock does not rise proportionally
bridge: EBITDA and operating cash flow rise
free cash flow rises if turnarounds/capex do not absorb the gain

PRODUCT_TANKER_TONMILES.shock: longer refined-product voyages and tighter effective tanker supply
PRODUCT_TANKER_TONMILES.earnings_channel: higher utilization and TCE/day rates can flow quickly into voyage and time-charter earnings
bridge: free cash flow rises after opex/debt service

CRUDE_TANKER_DISLOCATION.shock: crude sourcing shifts that increase VLCC/Suezmax ton-miles
CRUDE_TANKER_DISLOCATION.earnings_channel: higher ton-mile demand raises fleet utilization and spot freight cash margins

ATLANTIC_BARREL_PREMIUM.shock: structural substitution toward Atlantic Basin crude supply
ATLANTIC_BARREL_PREMIUM.earnings_channel: producers with exportable Atlantic barrels can capture higher realizations and/or volume growth

CEYHAN_BYPASS.shock: sustained Iraq-Turkey-Ceyhan export flow / Kurdistan payment normalization
CEYHAN_BYPASS.earnings_channel: restored export access can unlock previously constrained production volumes and cash receipts
bridge: pipeline flow becomes physical and sustained
FCF inflects from a depressed base

LNG_REROUTING.shock: LNG route disruption and Atlantic replacement demand
LNG_REROUTING.earnings_channel: liquefaction/export capacity and LNG shipping can benefit from destination spreads, utilization and longer voyages

ARSENAL_DEPLETION.shock: inventory depletion forces multi-year replenishment and production-target increases
ARSENAL_DEPLETION.earnings_channel: funded procurement converts into backlog, production volume and multi-year defense cash flow
bridge: revenue/EBIT and cash flow convert over several years

ROCKET_MOTOR_SHORTAGE.shock: solid-rocket-motor capacity becomes the binding missile-production constraint
ROCKET_MOTOR_SHORTAGE.earnings_channel: scarce qualified propulsion capacity can capture funded expansion, higher volumes and strategic pricing power
bridge: incremental EBIT/FCF accrues to bottleneck suppliers

ENERGETICS_SHORTAGE.shock: energetic materials/propellant capacity constrains ammunition and missile output
ENERGETICS_SHORTAGE.earnings_channel: qualified scarce materials and production lines can receive long-term contracts and capacity funding

STRATEGIC_ALUMINIUM.earnings_channel: producers with relevant smelting/conversion capacity can capture physical premiums and utilization gains

RARE_EARTH_MAGNET_SHORTAGE.shock: non-Chinese mining/separation/magnet capacity becomes strategically scarce
RARE_EARTH_MAGNET_SHORTAGE.earnings_channel: scarce domestic separation/refining/magnet capacity can capture price, contract and subsidy economics

CHEAP_DRONE_SCALING.shock: paid low-cost autonomous-drone procurement scales from prototypes to repeat volume
CHEAP_DRONE_SCALING.earnings_channel: repeat production volume can spread fixed engineering cost and create operating leverage
bridge: unit cost falls / gross profit scales

COUNTER_UAS_COST_CURVE.shock: militaries shift toward lower-cost EW/kinetic/laser/interceptor-drone counter-UAS solutions
COUNTER_UAS_COST_CURVE.earnings_channel: high-volume affordable intercept architecture can displace expensive missiles and expand addressable procurement
bridge: profit pool shifts toward cheaper counter-UAS stack

UNDERWATER_SECURITY.shock: mine warfare/subsea infrastructure threats force autonomous underwater-security procurement
UNDERWATER_SECURITY.earnings_channel: confirmed incidents can convert into sonar/UUV/mine-countermeasure backlog and service revenue
diluters: small program share at diversified primes

AI_TIME_TO_POWER.shock: grid interconnection, transformers, switchgear and generation become the binding AI-data-center constraint
AI_TIME_TO_POWER.earnings_channel: scarce electrical equipment/EPC capacity can capture backlog, pricing and utilization as customers pay for faster time-to-power
bridge: orders/deposits migrate to scarce equipment and EPC
EBIT and FCF expand through conversion
diluters: capacity additions that normalize lead times

AI_GHOST_DEMAND.shock: speculative interconnection demand is filtered out by deposits/financing requirements
AI_GHOST_DEMAND.earnings_channel: suppliers with hard backlog and financed projects gain relative quality as phantom demand disappears

BEHIND_METER_AI_POWER.shock: data centers bypass utility queues with onsite generation/microgrids
BEHIND_METER_AI_POWER.earnings_channel: distributed generation, turbines, engines, fuel cells and electrical balance-of-plant receive incremental orders
bridge: equipment and service cash flow grows

ROBOTICS_ACTUATOR_SCALE.shock: paid humanoid/industrial robot volumes scale and strain precision motion/actuator supply
ROBOTICS_ACTUATOR_SCALE.earnings_channel: qualified reducers, bearings, servo and motion components can capture volume and bottleneck pricing

ROBOTICS_DECOUPLING.shock: tariffs/procurement rules force Western robotics supply-chain localization
ROBOTICS_DECOUPLING.earnings_channel: protected suppliers can gain share and utilization as Chinese competition is restricted

JAPAN_CARRY_UNWIND.shock: yen strength/JGB repricing forces global carry deleveraging
JAPAN_CARRY_UNWIND.earnings_channel: exchange/market-infrastructure firms may benefit second-order from higher volumes and volatility rather than from the causal shock itself

GLOBAL_REFINANCING_STRESS.shock: higher refinancing cost transmits into corporate distress and private-credit opportunity
GLOBAL_REFINANCING_STRESS.earnings_channel: alternative managers can earn deployment/spread/opportunistic fees, but existing portfolio marks/defaults can offset the benefit

OT_CYBER_SHOCK.shock: cyberattack causes confirmed physical/industrial operational disruption
OT_CYBER_SHOCK.earnings_channel: mandatory remediation can accelerate industrial-network security, firewall, vulnerability and incident-response spend
bridge: high incremental software margin supports FCF
diluters: generic IT exposure rather than OT

NUCLEAR_FUEL_SOVEREIGNTY.shock: Western conversion/enrichment/HALEU/fuel-cycle capacity becomes strategically scarce
NUCLEAR_FUEL_SOVEREIGNTY.earnings_channel: qualified non-Russian fuel-cycle capacity can capture long-term offtake, premium pricing and government-funded expansion
bridge: FCF scales as capacity comes online

MILITARY_ENERGY_AUTONOMY.shock: bases/platforms require resilient autonomous power and microgrids
MILITARY_ENERGY_AUTONOMY.earnings_channel: nuclear/microgrid/generation suppliers can win long-duration funded programs and service streams
bridge: service and equipment cash flow follow

EUROPE_STRATEGIC_AUTONOMY.shock: Europe shifts defense procurement toward sovereign capacity and multi-year rearmament
EUROPE_STRATEGIC_AUTONOMY.earnings_channel: European primes and strategic suppliers can capture sustained backlog, capacity funding and higher utilization

OIL_SERVICE_CAPEX_SECOND_WAVE.shock: sustained producer cash flow triggers a second wave of oilfield-service capacity spending
OIL_SERVICE_CAPEX_SECOND_WAVE.earnings_channel: tight service fleets and specialist equipment can capture utilization and pricing as upstream capex expands
